# Crews run Tanager on the handsets they already carry

## Decision Question

Does Ashgrove issue rugged tablets for the Tanager rollout, or does the app run on the phones the crews are already carrying?

## Decision Outcome

No tablets. Tanager runs on the existing handsets and the device estate does not change for this programme.

## Alternatives Considered

- Issue rugged tablets to the pilot depot only, which Quillon recommended on screen size and which Marta Kubik read as a second thing for a tech to leave on a wall.
- Issue tablets across all four depots at once, costed off the standing framework rate and never sponsored by anyone.

## Approved By

Marta Kubik at the 2026-03-10 mobilisation session. Deshawn Pryor noted that the device management profile already covers the handsets and would have to be extended to anything new.

## Context

The handsets sit on a refresh cycle that closes in 2027, so this has a shelf life rather than a conclusion. Reversible: nothing in Tanager assumes a screen size, and the cost of reversing is procurement time rather than rework.
